about: Taiwan CS Theory Day in Hsinchu is a continuing event series that aims to bring together international and domestic researchers in theoretical computer science to meet, exchange ideas, and share recent developments in the field. Through this event, we also aim to expose students to frontier research in theoretical computer science and to inspire the next generation of researchers to pursue advanced study and careers in the future. This edition marks the second event in the series, building upon the previous edition known as NYCU Theory Day. With this event, we hope to connect the local research community with the broader theoretical computer science community in Taiwan and beyond.

The NYCU Hsinchu (Chiaotung) Campus is located adjacent to the Hsinchu Science Park, one of the world's major centers for the semiconductor and high-tech industries. This places NYCU in a uniquely vibrant research environment, where fundamental questions in computation meet the technologies that shape the future.

The tradition of Taiwan Theory Day events dates back to 2016 (see https://theoryday.github.io/), providing a forum for Taiwan's theoretical computer science community to gather and exchange ideas. We are delighted to contribute to this tradition by hosting Theory Day events regularly at NYCU, and we warmly welcome researchers and students from Taiwan and around the world to join us in Hsinchu.

registration: Registration is in general free of charge for all participants. For non-student participants, if you would like to sponsor this event, we welcome sponsorship registration as well.
To manage logistics and arrangements, we kindly ask all participants to register. We look forward to seeing you at this event.
